pages.text: A Cursed Energy Core's material is decided by the fluid injected during the ritual (the melting recipes from fluid -> material). Core parts are tallied by their $(bold)head$(), and only the material's $(bold)default traits$() apply - armor-exclusive traits (perStat: armor) never appear on cores.$(br2)$(bold)Regular materials$():$(li)$(l:material_ashen_ink)Ashen Ink$() (T3)$(li)$(l:material_dragonbone)Dragonbone$() (T1)$(li)$(l:material_dragonsteel_fire)Dragonsteel Fire$() (T3)$(li)$(l:material_dragonsteel_ice)Dragonsteel Ice$() (T3)$(li)$(l:material_dragonsteel_lightning)Dragonsteel Lightning$() (T3)$(li)$(l:material_dreadsteel)Dreadsteel$() (T4)$(li)$(l:material_durandal)Durandal$() (special)$(li)$(l:material_gheloth_remains)Gheloth Remains$() (T4)$(li)$(l:material_hastur_malice)Hastur's Malice$() (T2)$(li)$(l:material_nicholas_blessing)Life Impulse$() (T3)$(br2)$(bold)Iron's Spells crossover materials$():$(li)$(l:material_holy_spirit)Holy Spirit$(): divine soulshard 250mB + arcane ingot 90mB -> 360mB alloy; handle/binding/maille/arrow shaft; Arcane Conduction + Tilos Purgatory$(li)$(l:material_formless_ice)Formless Ice$(): permafrost shard 500mB / frosted helve 150mB (+50mB Liquid Arcane byproduct); handle/bow limb/binding; Cold-Blooded + Endless Cold Wind$(li)$(l:material_pyrium)Pyrium$(): ingot 90mB / 45mB ash + 45mB molten gold -> 90mB; head/handle/limb/grip + all armor and shields; Blazing + Holy War Relic + Ancient Sanctuary$(li)$(l:material_arcane_iron)Arcane Iron$(): arcane ingot 90mB / 45mB Liquid Arcane + 45mB molten iron -> 90mB; head/handle/limb/grip + armor and shields; Arcane Conduction + Magnetic + Magic Conduction$(li)$(l:material_mithril)Mithril$(): raw mithril 30mB / scrap 20mB / ingot 90mB; head/binding/handle/limb/grip; Focus + Spell Break$(li)$(l:material_magic_gold)Magic Gold$() (T4): 90mB Molten Pyrium + 90mB Molten Mithril + 90mB Molten Arcane Ingot -> 180mB Magic Gold Essence; head/binding/handle/limb/grip + all armor and shields + maille; Super-Tier Magic + Myriad Spells as One + Arcane Domination + Mana Armor$(br2)For the effects of each material's traits, see the $(l:trait_overview)Combat Traits$() chapter.$(br2)$(bold)Casting loops$(): every crossover fluid can be cast back into its source item (ingot -> ingot cast, shard -> gem cast, essence -> nugget cast) with the fluid amount matching the melting amount. The pure-alloy fluids (Magic Gold Essence / Holy Spirit) have no melting source, so they got $(bold)Magic Gold Ingots$() and $(bold)Holy Spirit Ingots$() as their item forms.
